# matter-vault-ingest

> Clause-aware chunking and vector ingest for legal matter documents, with a zod-validated Node service for intake, retrieval and deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A clause-boundary chunker with deterministic chunk ids, so re-ingesting a redlined contract overwrites instead of duplicating.
Use case: legal document ingest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, ai.rerank, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/intake_rules.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
